description: CUSIP check digit. Nine characters from digits, letters, and * @ #. Spaces are ignored and hyphens are not. From the left, values are weighted 1, 2, 1, 2 and the digits of those products sum to the check digit. A CUSIP made only of letters and digits is also returned as a US ISIN. This does not look the issuer up. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cusip-validate
name: cusip_validate
title: Cusip Validate
